title: Circuit literal evaluation agrees with its encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ assign a truth proposition to every input or gate variable of a tree circuit on $n$ inputs, and let $u$ be a Boolean assignment to its inputs. Suppose that $u(i)$ is true exactly when $\alpha$ makes input $i$ true, for every input $i$. Then for every literal $l$, the circuit literal associated with $l$ is true under $\alpha$ exactly when $l$ evaluates to true under $u$.
hypotheses_covered: For every input $i$, $u(i)=\mathrm{true}$ iff $\alpha$ makes input $i$ true
